name: Console commands
author: Brett
description: Tell Amber (any Claude session) to load a screen and your open console goes there: open any screen, dialog or settings tab (sub-tabs too) by id, title or a few words, run any registered action, go back or home, and list what the console has. The control@1 console domain over REST (/api/console), MCP tools console_open, console_dialog, console_settings, console_action, console_back, console_where, console_list, console_clients and console_screenshot (a PNG of what the console shows plus its screen state, read-only) on the console's /mcp (and through axHub), and the CLI `axf console …`. For voice calls, where a picture never reaches Amber: console_screenshot also describes the screen in words (a vision-capable Claude model through the AI assistant's providers) and lists every element that can be pressed, numbered, and console_click, console_right_click, console_double_click, console_context_menu, console_menu, console_expand, console_collapse, console_jump, console_scroll, console_type and console_key act on a target named by words, a number, an address or coordinates (console-screen@1). Opening and moving only navigate; an action that changes data keeps its own permission, and one that deletes or resets needs a confirm token. Commands go to the console you used last (or all of them, or one).
